newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada auto union head hopes for deal with GM.
newsitem.headline: Canada auto union head hopes for deal with GM.

text.p: Canadian Auto Workers union president Buzz Hargrove said on Monday he is hopeful an agreement can be reached with General Motors Corp in the next few hours to end a strike by 26,000 Canadian auto workers.

"We have some tough hurdles to jump," Hargrove told a televised news conference during a break in talks with GM chief negotiator Dean Munger. "But we are both determined and our bargaining committees are determined that we're going to keep at this thing and hopefully sometime in the next...two, three or four hours, we'll be able to announce a tentative agreement."

Low said the sticking points remained over notification periods for mandatory overtime and cancellation.
